common_configuration.mcp_timeout_scope: per launch attempt; covers process startup, initialize, tools/list, and all tools/call requests
common_configuration.environment: Docker Desktop, Linux arm64, Node.js 22, Go 1.24, Rust 1.93
common_configuration.isolation: workspace read-only; repository sources and build outputs stored in a dedicated Docker volume

notes: The targeted run reused dependency artifacts created during the shallow run, so build-time values must not be compared between modes.
The targeted mode changes both tool selection and call budget and also injects canaries; differences must not be attributed solely to the number of calls.
Seven repositories failed in both modes because their MCP processes closed stdout before returning a JSON response.
One additional targeted repository, 21st-dev/magic-mcp, exhausted the 90-second deadline for all three launch variants.
